subject.title: Evaluate stale re-review command-status comment cleanup

question: Should ClawSweeper preserve, mark/edit, or delete stale older-head trusted-bot `re_review` command-status comments after a newer status comment supersedes them?
rationale: The code can implement any of the options, but deletion or mutation changes public operational history, so automation should not infer the retention policy from the existing duplicate-ack cleanup.

options.title: Preserve or Mark Stale
options.body: Keep the audit trail by default and, if noise is a problem, only edit trusted bot status comments to make the stale state explicit.

options.title: Delete Narrow Trusted Statuses
options.body: Delete only older-head trusted-bot `re_review` status comments after a newer status is selected, with durable review and human comments excluded.

options.title: Leave Current Cleanup Only
options.body: Keep the existing duplicate-ack convergence behavior and accept visible older-head command-status comments as audit history.

recommendation.title: Preserve or Mark Stale
recommendation.body: Keep the audit trail by default and, if noise is a problem, only edit trusted bot status comments to make the stale state explicit.

likelyOwner.reason: Momo is the strongest source-history owner for the current command-status selection and cleanup behavior.
